boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Ithaca College spaces for quiet reading, group projects, writing support, media production, and hands-on academic work, with current access details.

cards.entity_name: Ithaca College Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Bring the Project Team
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms in Ithaca College Library
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a two-to-eight-person project, then bring the files or materials your group needs to work through together.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed library rooms designed for collaborative assignments and projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ithaca College Library identifies reservable group study rooms as suitable for groups of two to eight people.
cards.access_notes: Advance reservation is available through the library’s LibCal system; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ithaca College Library Fourth and Fifth Floors
cards.title: Settle Into the Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Quiet study on the library’s upper levels
cards.notes: Head to the fourth or fifth floor for focused reading, and keep calls, recordings, and collaborative conversation elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Two designated upper floors for concentration without group-room activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s current policy identifies its fourth and fifth floors as quiet-study space and prohibits filming or recording there.
cards.source_title: Filming, Photography, and Recording in the Library
cards.access_notes: Use only during normal library operating hours and follow quiet-floor rules; filming and recording are prohibited.

cards.title: Work Through a Draft
cards.subtitle: One-on-one writing support in Smiddy Hall
cards.notes: Book a conference and bring your prompt, draft, and questions so a trained tutor can help you strengthen your own revision process.
cards.short_summary: A focused destination for guided work on writing at any stage.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College states that Smiddy 107 hosts Writing Center tutoring Monday through Friday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Appointments are recommended and booked through MyWCOnline; published hours are Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Take the Evening Writing Shift
cards.subtitle: Library cubicles with scheduled Writing Center support
cards.notes: Use an evening appointment to untangle a paper, bringing the assignment and current draft for a concentrated tutoring session.
cards.short_summary: Second-floor cubicles paired with evening writing consultations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center lists Gannett Center Library second-floor cubicles as its Sunday-through-Thursday evening location from 7 to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Writing Center appointments are recommended; the published evening schedule is Sunday–Thursday, 7–10 p.m.

cards.title: Study With a Computer Nearby
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring individual work when you want a social setting, and use one of the three available computers if your task needs a campus workstation.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge combining seating, computers, and a projector.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College says the third-floor Unity Student Lounge offers study seating, three computers, and access whenever the Campus Center is open.
cards.access_notes: The lounge is open while the Campus Center building is open; current building hours may vary during breaks and summer.

cards.title: Open the Laptop Between Classes
cards.subtitle: A named lounge inside the Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the lounge for portable work between classes, but check the campus events calendar before relying on it for uninterrupted study.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center lounge suited to informal, flexible study.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College’s official events site names Clark Lounge as a Campus Center place to relax between classes and describes the building as a study destination.
cards.access_notes: Open access depends on Campus Center hours and scheduled events; the source does not promise exclusive study use.

cards.title: Spread Out for Flexible Work
cards.subtitle: Campus Center seating for informal study
cards.notes: Choose this named lounge for reading or laptop work, and keep a backup location ready when college programs occupy the room.
cards.short_summary: An informal Campus Center setting for work outside a classroom.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Ithaca College events page identifies Klingenstein Lounge among the Campus Center lounges available for relaxing between classes.
cards.access_notes: Availability follows Campus Center building access and may be affected by events; verify the calendar before settling in.

cards.title: Build a Group Work Zone
cards.subtitle: Reservable active-learning room in Friends Hall
cards.notes: Reserve the lab for a group session, then rearrange the mobile furniture and connect work to one of the dedicated displays.
cards.short_summary: A configurable 24-seat room with displays, charging, and mobile furniture.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College says Friends 110c seats 24, has mobile furniture, multiple displays and charging stations, and is reservable through 25Live.
cards.access_notes: Faculty, staff, and students must reserve the room through 25Live for classes, meetings, workshops, or group sessions.

cards.title: Prototype While You Learn
cards.subtitle: Hands-on workspace in Friends 101 and 102
cards.notes: Walk in during staffed hours with a project idea, and ask for guidance before using unfamiliar fabrication or crafting equipment.
cards.short_summary: A staffed workspace for making, prototyping, and project-based learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The IC Makerspace is open to students, staff, and faculty and provides tools including 3D printers, a laser cutter, sewing machines, and Cricuts.
cards.access_notes: Located in Friends 101–102; Fall 2026 hours are Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m. and Saturday noon–4 p.m., with no appointment required.

cards.title: Edit, Record, or Model
cards.subtitle: Production workspace open to the IC community
cards.notes: Reserve the equipment your project requires, then use the editing computers, recording tools, or studio setup for focused production work.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich workspace for audio, video, VR, and 3D projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College says Job 102 is open to all students, staff, and faculty and provides production equipment, studios, VR headsets, and editing computers.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are used for the podcast studio, equipment loans, and VR; check the current lab schedule because closures may occur.
